phases.name: Introduction
phases.description: Introduction to the serious game mechanics and environment
phases.phase_introduction: The AI initiative has officially kicked off across the organization. The project stakeholders have convened to establish working relationships and review initial expectations.

phases.name: Requirement Engineering
phases.description: Business goal definition and stakeholder alignment
phases.phase_introduction: Following the kickoff, management formally greenlit the project budget and timeline. The core team has now reconvened to hammer out concrete business goals and system constraints.

phases.name: Data Engineering
phases.description: Dataset preparation, addressing data quality, accessibility, and privacy.
phases.phase_introduction: With initial requirements signed off, access was granted to internal databases and legacy systems. The engineering team has begun extracting raw records and investigating data quality across sources.

phases.name: Model Engineering
phases.description: Design, training, and evaluation of ML models.
phases.phase_introduction: Data ingestion and cleaning pipelines have delivered the first unified training sets. The data science team has taken over the environment to begin model experimentation and architecture evaluation.

phases.name: Model Deployment
phases.description: Integration of models into production systems.
phases.phase_introduction: The candidate model successfully passed offline benchmarks and validation suites. The DevOps and engineering teams have stepped in to build the production release pipelines and integrate system services.

phases.name: Monitoring/ Usage
phases.phase_introduction: The ML model has been running in production, processing live user transactions. Telemetry dashboards and customer feedback loops have started streaming operational performance data.

challenges.name: The Introduction
challenges.description: #model_monica# proposes a complex ML model for maximizing accuracy. #efficiency_emilia# argues that a simpler model would be sufficient and could generate more business value.
challenges.roundIntroduction: This sample challenge introduces you to the game and its mechanics.

challenges.name: The Platform Choice
challenges.description: For minimizing the development effort, #efficiency_emilia# proposes to use a cloud-based 3rd-party managed MLOps platform. #requirements_reuben# warns that the platform may not fully meet the projects requirements and instead argues for designing and developing a custom platform that fits the projects requirements.
challenges.roundIntroduction: Moving to system and architecture design, the team faces a fundamental dilemma: should they build a custom platform or buy a managed solution?

challenges.name: The Data Instability
challenges.description: #data_dave# warns that changes in input signals can unpredictably degrade model performance and advocates creating versioned copies so that each model version uses a fixed snapshot of its inputs. #reliability_ruth# points out that a stale signal will get outdated leading to degrading performance when the model is not frequently retrained with new signal snapshots.
challenges.roundIntroduction: During data analysis, it was revealed that a data source changes its behavior over time.
challenges.Source: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems

challenges.name: The Entanglement Problem
challenges.description: #data_dave# warns that this additional complexity will lead to feature entaglement, where any change in feature weights, distribution or quantity have unpredictable effects on the model's performance. This makes isolation of improvement impossible. Hence, he proposes to instead use an ensemblement model that relies on multiple component models with independent signals. #model_monica# warns that this would come with a higher complexity and may hurt the model's performance.
challenges.roundIntroduction: With data extraction and preparation completed, the team moves towards finding a suitable model architecture. The ML prediction will have to be based on multiple signals from different sources, but integrating them seamlessly threatens to destabilize the entire system.
challenges.Source: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems

challenges.name: The Automation Risk
challenges.description: To comply with CI/CD, #automation_alex# proposes a fully automated deployment and validation process. #requirements_reuben# warns that an automated validation may violate responsible AI practices as fairness and bias identification may fall short.
challenges.roundIntroduction: A ML model that matches the performance goals has been selected for production, but scaling it introduces new hurdles. As the team prepares the deployment pipeline, a conflict arises over how to safely push the model without compromising ethical standards.

challenges.name: Model Accuracy Drops
challenges.description: The deployed model shows declining accuracy as live data drifts away from training data. #efficiency_emilia# is concerned about business impact and requests a rapid retraining. #reliability_ruth# argues that a quick quick damage control without diagnosis and validation risks locking in bad patterns and increase instability.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The ML solution has been running successfully in production until a subtle but concerning trend emerges.
challenges.Source: Learning in Nonstationary Environments: A Survey.

challenges.name: The Inconsistent Checks
challenges.description: #data_dave# insists on keeping the quality checks manually done to control costs. #reliability_ruth# argues for full automation to ensure consistent results.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The data quality checks have become inconsistent, causing delays in the pipeline. #data_dave# and #reliability_ruth# disagree on how to fix the situation.

stalemate_ops.reason: data validation steps are not aligned

challenges.name: Tracking Reproducibility Lost
challenges.description: #model_monica# insists on automated experiment tracking to ensure reproducibility. #data_dave# thinks that is overkill and wants to keep it manual to save costs. The team is stuck.
challenges.roundIntroduction: A recent audit flagged gaps in model reproducibility. The team needs to agree on how to track experiments.

on_enter_ops.reason: the audit team found gaps in reproducibility
the audit team found gaps in reproducibility

stalemate_ops.reason: the audit team found gaps in reproducibility

challenges.name: Inconsistent Data Labeling
challenges.description: #reliability_ruth# believes that labeling should be fully automated and governed to ensure consistent data quality. #data_dave# wants to keep it manual for flexibility. #data_dave# is willing to compromise on a semi-manual approach, but #reliability_ruth# insists on strict governance.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The data labeling pipeline has been inconsistent, causing issues in model training. The team needs to decide on the right approach to ensure reliable data quality.

on_enter_ops.reason: the labeling pipeline produced inconsistent results

stalemate_ops.reason: the labeling pipeline breaks due to unresolved conflicts

challenges.name: Registry Red Tape
challenges.description: #model_monica# insists the model registry must be automated; they can't work without it. But #requirements_reuben# won't allow it, insisting it must be governed first. #model_monica# says that's a nonstarter.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The team is arguing about the model registry. The registry is still just a spreadsheet, but #model_monica# says it's getting too hard to manage. #requirements_reuben# worries about compliance risks.

stalemate_ops.reason: the registry is no longer trusted

challenges.name: The Blind Spot
challenges.description: Production metrics have stopped flowing to the team. #efficiency_emilia# argues that a manual monthly audit is sufficient to keep costs down and maintain control over the business KPIs. #reliability_ruth# insists on automated and governed monitoring to catch real-time degradation and ensure the system remains reliable for users.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The nightly data pipeline failed to ingest the latest batch of inference logs. The dashboard now shows a flat line for the last 48 hours, leaving the team blind to current model performance.

stalemate_ops.reason: alerting rule disabled due to lack of data

challenges.name: The Silent Drift
challenges.description: The production drift monitoring pipeline is broken, leaving the model's input quality unchecked. #efficiency_emilia# insists on a fully automated and governed drift monitoring system to protect business KPIs, while #reliability_ruth# argues that manual weekly reviews are sufficient and cheaper. #efficiency_emilia# has set a red line requiring automated governance for any future drift detection.
challenges.roundIntroduction: A recent data shift went unnoticed for three days, causing a spike in user complaints. The incident exposed that the drift monitoring workflow is currently non-functional and needs immediate repair.

on_enter_ops.reason: The drift detection script crashed due to a schema change

stalemate_ops.reason: The data feed to the drift monitor was disconnected

challenges.name: Exposed Model Endpoint
challenges.description: A security audit revealed that the API gateway lacks proper authentication controls, exposing model endpoints to unauthorized access. #automation_alex# argues for keeping the gateway in a manual state to avoid disrupting the current deployment pipeline, while #requirements_reuben# insists on a fully governed state to ensure compliance and security.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The security team flagged a critical vulnerability in the API gateway configuration. The current setup allows unauthenticated requests to reach the model serving endpoints.

on_enter_ops.reason: The gateway crashed during a security patch attempt

stalemate_ops.reason: The team paused canary testing to focus on the gateway crisis

challenges.name: The Missing Baseline
challenges.description: The KPI definitions were never formally agreed, leaving the project without a clear target for success. #efficiency_emilia# wants the KPI definition to be fully automated and governed to ensure alignment with business goals, while #requirements_reuben# argues it should remain a manual process to allow for careful security and compliance review. #efficiency_emilia# is open to a compromise that keeps the process manual but documented, but #requirements_reuben# insists on strict manual control.
challenges.roundIntroduction: A recent audit revealed that the KPI definitions were lost during a team transition. The team is now scrambling to redefine the success metrics before the next sprint planning session.

on_enter_ops.reason: the previous KPI document was deleted during cleanup

stalemate_ops.reason: without agreed KPIs, acceptance criteria cannot be validated

challenges.name: The Silent Shadow
challenges.description: #reliability_ruth# insists on a fully automated and governed shadow deployment to validate model behavior before release, while #automation_alex# argues that the shadow environment is redundant and should be removed entirely to reduce infrastructure complexity. #automation_alex# has a red line against maintaining any shadow infrastructure and will not move on this point.
challenges.roundIntroduction: A recent model update caused unexpected latency spikes in production, and the team realized there was no safe way to test the new version against live traffic without risking user experience. The shadow deployment environment, which was previously manual, has now broken completely, leaving the team without a safety net for future releases.

on_enter_ops.reason: the shadow environment crashed during a load test

stalemate_ops.reason: the pipeline trigger for shadow testing was disabled

challenges.name: The Missing Gate
challenges.description: A critical compliance audit has revealed that our model promotion process lacks a formal quality gate. #requirements_reuben# insists that acceptance criteria must be fully automated and governed to meet security standards, and he will not compromise on this. #automation_alex# argues that the current manual checks are sufficient for now and that building an automated gate will delay the release of new features.
challenges.roundIntroduction: The compliance team has flagged a gap in our production pipeline where models are deployed without verified acceptance criteria. This has left the team scrambling to decide how to handle the validation step immediately.

on_enter_ops.reason: The compliance audit found no defined criteria for model approval

stalemate_ops.reason: Uncertainty over acceptance criteria has frozen the business metric definitions
